title: Global Meeting Time Analysis: Optimal Overlap Windows for Distributed Teams
methodology: Analyzed 10,000 simulated team distributions across 200+ cities using World Time Sync meeting planner algorithm. Measured overlap hours in standard business window (08:00-18:00 local).
recommendations: Adopt weekly rotation for US-EU-APAC teams
Use async-first communication (Loom, Notion, Slack threads)
Automate DST transition reminders 2 weeks prior
data_source: World Time Sync Meeting Planner simulation, 2026-07-09
